scenarios.scenario_abstract: While learning a repeatable washing-machine routine, [X] separates jeans, exercise bottoms, everyday lower garments, and delicate pieces by weight and care label before choosing the cycle, water temperature, spin, and drying method for each load.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在学习一套可重复的洗衣机使用流程时，[X]会先按重量和洗护标签分开牛仔裤、运动下装、日常下装与精细衣物，再为每一批选择洗涤程序、水温、脱水强度和干燥方式。
examples: washing sturdy Cotton, Linen, or Polyester bottoms together only when their labels and colors are compatible
keeping Nylon- or Spandex-rich exercise bottoms away from damaging dryer heat so stretch can recover

moving Wool, Silk, Rayon, Acrylic Fiber, or Bamboo Fiber pieces to gentler handling and excluding Leather, Faux Leather, Neoprene, or Polyolefin constructions unless their labels explicitly permit the process

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before putting the exact suit through a home washer, [X] checks whether the trousers and jacket can be cleaned together without one half shrinking, shining, losing shape, or finishing differently from the other.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在把现有的西装放入家用洗衣机之前，[X]会先检查这条具体的西裤与西装外套能否一起清洗，避免其中一件缩水、发亮、变形，或洗后质感与另一件不再匹配。
examples: sending Wool- or Silk-based construction to a cleaner when water could distort the matched set
using separate mesh bags, a cold delicate cycle, low spin, and reshaping for explicitly washable Polyester, Cotton, Rayon, or Linen blends
keeping Leather or Faux Leather trim out of the machine and treating any elastic or technical panel according to its own label

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a summer trip to Italy, [X] compares shorts and light trousers for walking comfort and polish, then checks fiber percentages, sustainability evidence, delivery, and returns rather than accepting a green slogan.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为准备意大利夏季旅行，[X]会比较既适合长时间步行、又能保持利落感的短裤和轻薄长裤，并核对纤维比例、可持续证据、配送与退货，而不是只相信环保口号。
examples: favoring Cotton, Linen, Rayon, or Bamboo Fiber when breathability and soft drape matter in summer heat
checking whether a Polyester, Nylon, or Polyolefin claim is recycled and whether the finished bottom will manage sweat without feeling plasticky
rejecting a Leather, Faux Leather, Acrylic Fiber, or heavily insulated construction when its heat, care, or return burden conflicts with the trip

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a four-day Mpumalanga reserve and waterfall trip, [X] limits the lower-body packing list to shorts or convertible trousers that can handle humid hikes, slippery spray, thunderstorms, and overnight drying without carrying a second bulky wardrobe.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在前往姆普马兰加进行四天保护区与瀑布旅行前，[X]会把下装限制为短裤或可拆卸长裤，要求它们能应对潮湿徒步、瀑布水雾、雷雨和隔夜晾干，而不必额外携带一套笨重衣物。
examples: avoiding heavy denim or absorbent Cotton when it may remain wet for hours on the trail
using quick-drying Polyester, Nylon, or Polyolefin for repeated wet-to-dry transitions
adding Spandex for climbing and stride freedom while reserving Neoprene only for sustained water exposure that justifies its bulk

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo September trip to Iceland, [X] builds one lower-body layering system that must work during heated driving as well as near-freezing wind, rain, hot-spring stops, and nights in a camper with little room to dry wet clothing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为准备九月独自前往冰岛，[X]会搭配一套下身分层系统，既要适应有暖气的长途驾驶，也要应对接近冰点的风雨、温泉停留，以及在缺少晾衣空间的露营车中过夜。
examples: using Wool or Acrylic Fiber in a base layer when warmth must persist through damp outdoor stops
using Polyester, Nylon, or Polyolefin in an outer trouser when wind resistance and rapid drying outweigh natural feel
using Spandex for layered mobility or Neoprene for concentrated cold-water exposure, while rejecting slow-drying Cotton, Linen, Rayon, Bamboo Fiber, or delicate Silk for the exposed layer

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week in Jaipur, [X] packs only two or three bottoms that can balance long fort and market walks, severe daytime heat, strong indoor air-conditioning, dust, and temple visits requiring the knees to remain covered.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一周的斋浦尔行程准备衣物时，[X]只带两三件下装，同时要兼顾城堡与市场的长时间步行、白天酷热、室内强冷气、尘土，以及需要遮住膝盖的寺庙参观。
examples: choosing Cotton or Linen trousers when airflow and modest coverage must coexist
considering Rayon or Bamboo Fiber when soft drape still permits repeated walking and simple care
rejecting heavy Polyester, Acrylic Fiber, Leather, Faux Leather, or Neoprene when trapped heat and limited rewear dominate

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a five-day capsule for travel across very different climates, [X] assigns each bottom a role in heat, cold, rain, or large temperature swings and rejects pieces that duplicate one another, remain wet too long, or consume too much luggage space.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为跨越多种气候的旅行规划五天胶囊行李时，[X]会让每件下装分别承担炎热、寒冷、雨天或大温差环境中的作用，并淘汰功能重复、久湿不干或过度占用行李空间的款式。
examples: using Linen, Cotton, Rayon, or Bamboo Fiber for dry heat but checking whether humidity changes the decision
using Wool or Acrylic Fiber for cold insulation and Silk only where a delicate dress role is worth the care burden

using Polyester, Nylon, Polyolefin, Spandex, or Neoprene for quick drying, stretch, shells, or water exposure, while comparing Leather and Faux Leather mainly through bulk, heat, and weather tolerance

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week at a managed forest campsite, [X] chooses base bottoms, hiking trousers, and rain over-trousers for damp ground, temperature changes, repeated wear, and limited washing while keeping the shared packing list and budget manageable.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备在管理规范的森林营地住一周时，[X]需要为潮湿地面、温差、反复穿着和有限洗衣条件选择打底下装、徒步长裤与防雨罩裤，同时控制共同装备清单和预算。
examples: avoiding Cotton jeans when retained moisture would remove warmth and take too long to dry
combining Wool insulation with Polyester, Nylon, or Polyolefin hiking and shell layers

using Spandex for movement and Neoprene only for wet activities, while rejecting Silk, Rayon, Linen, Bamboo Fiber, Leather, Faux Leather, or Acrylic Fiber when care, abrasion, or drying conflicts with the campsite

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a small everyday wardrobe for school, [X] compares jeans, chinos, joggers, and skirts for long class days, repeated washing, wrinkle tolerance, mix-and-match use, and a limited budget instead of assuming that the trendiest or most expensive option will last best.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为学校生活建立精简日常衣橱时，[X]会围绕长时间上课、反复洗涤、抗皱需求、混搭能力和有限预算比较牛仔裤、卡其裤、慢跑裤与半身裙，而不是默认最流行或最贵的选择一定最耐用。
examples: choosing Cotton for comfort while checking whether repeated washing and slow drying fit the routine
using Polyester or Nylon when durability and low maintenance matter, then checking Spandex recovery rather than accepting a vague stretch claim
comparing organic plant fibers with recycled synthetics through both resource use and expected garment lifetime

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For hilly rides and family outings, [X] adds rain trousers and checks whether the lower layer blocks road spray at the seams, vents pedaling heat, moves without binding, grips safely around the bike, and packs away after the weather clears.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为丘陵骑行和家庭出游增添防雨长裤时，[X]会检查下装能否在接缝处挡住路面飞溅、排出踩踏产生的热量、活动时不受束缚、靠近车身时保持安全，并在雨停后便于收纳。
examples: using Polyester, Nylon, or Polyolefin with sealed seams when spray protection and packability are central
using Spandex panels only where stretch does not compromise weather protection
reserving Neoprene for colder sustained wet exposure and rejecting absorbent Cotton, delicate Silk, or rigid Leather and Faux Leather when they conflict with pedaling and drying
